measurements.name: rgb_strict_default
measurements.interpretation: The strict default defers the dense CBD scene as shadow-uncertain and misses every confirmed reference change.

measurements.name: rgb_high_recall_experimental
measurements.interpretation: The configuration recovers all confirmed benchmark changes, but is not operationally accepted: fragments and additional candidates need shadow-risk annotation, grouping, and a separate hold-out check.

warning: This benchmark has only seven human-confirmed changes. It can guide exploration but cannot by itself set a production threshold.
